description: This file defines the final class 'UriNormalizer' in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, providing static methods and constants for normalizing URIs according to RFC 3986 standards. It includes methods to normalize URIs, compare their equivalence, and constants for different normalization options.

classes.name: UriNormalizer
classes.description: Provides static methods and constants to perform normalization, comparison, and processing of URIs to ensure consistent formatting and semantics according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized URI based on specified flags such as capitalizing percent-encodings, decoding unreserved characters, converting empty paths, removing default host and port, removing dot segments, duplicate slashes, and sorting query parameters.

methods.name: isEquivalent
methods.description: Checks whether two URIs are equivalent after normalization, considering optional normalization flags.
